reasoning: 驗證送出 EPB Maintenance Mode 請求後 T_EPB_MM 逾時而未收到 IPC 有效回應時，TLM 判定 EPB 模組無回應並顯示 No response from EPB module popup。關鍵情境為逾時分支，屬模擬故障（不送回應）。本 Req 述單一逾時路徑，1 條即足；有回應之各分支由 -047／-048…-052 覆蓋。T_EPB_MM = 35000 ms、容差 200 ms 取自規格常數表，不臆造。

tcs.tc_title: No IPC response before T_EPB_MM expires
pre_conditions: The EPB Maintenance Mode menu item is displayed
The EPB Maintenance Mode setting is Off
test_procedure: Select "EPB Maintenance Mode" = "On" to trigger $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ signal transmission
Suppress transmission of $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode$ and $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ on the bus
Read the named UI element "No response from EPB module" pop-up and check that it is displayed
expected_result: No value of $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode$ or $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ is received
The signal is held for 35000 ms
The named UI element "No response from EPB module" pop-up is displayed
tcs.design_method: 基礎故障注入 (Fault Injection Lite)
tcs.test_item:
If no valid response is received before T_EPB_MM expires, the TLM shall determine that the EPB module is not responding and shall activate and display the "No response from EPB module" popup
(T_EPB_MM timeout with no IPC response raises the no-response popup)

distinguishing_axis.delta: T_EPB_MM 35000 ms 逾時且無任何 IPC 回應，與各 Fdbk 值分支之有回應不同

tcs.remarks: T_EPB_MM = 35000 ms, tolerance 200 ms per the spec constant table
